meta.name: muapi-character-story-video
meta.description: Create a multi-part animated story video by first establishing a consistent character and then generating sequential scenes and animating them.

copy.tagline: 用统一角色生成多段动画故事视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用AI快速制作角色统一的动画故事视频
copy.tagline_en: Create multi-part animated story videos with a consistent character
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly produce animated story videos with consistent characters using AI

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会先根据你的描述生成一个卡通角色形象，然后围绕这个角色创作三幕故事场景图，最后把每张图变成短视频片段，组成一个完整的动画故事。
howto.when: 当你提到“角色故事”、“故事视频”、“动画故事”等关键词，或者要求制作多段式动画视频时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于小猪造火箭飞向太空的动画故事。
say.note: Claude 会先创建角色，再生成三幕场景并动画化。

say.text: 用这张参考图，讲一个猫咪侦探破案的故事视频。
say.note: 上传图片后，Claude 会保持角色一致生成故事。

howto.what_en: Claude first creates a consistent character based on your description, then generates three sequential story scene images, and finally animates each scene into short video clips to form a complete animated story.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'character story', 'story video', 'animated story', or request a multi-part animated video.

say_en.text: Create an animated story about a piglet building a jetpack and flying to space.
say_en.note: Claude will create the character, generate scenes, and animate them.

say_en.text: Use this reference image to make a story video about a cat detective solving a case.
say_en.note: Upload an image; Claude will keep the character consistent throughout.
